implementation_notes: Draft adds REST routes for all frozen API paths. Human routes use ClaimOperations.transition; /api/system/** routes use systemTransition, and actor identity comes only from AuthenticatedActors.from(Authentication).

Request records use bean validation, strict unknown-property handling is enabled for JSON, and API JSON bodies are capped at 64 KiB by a bounded byte read that handles unknown content length. Errors use {code,message,traceId,details}; domain errors preserve status, malformed/validation/conversion errors return 400, unexpected errors return a generic 500.

Static workspace uses same-origin fetch and in-memory Basic credentials, clears password field after sign-in, fetches CSRF token/header from /api/session, escapes dynamic text through textContent, offers role-specific fact forms and dynamically rendered configured transitions/audit.

Tests drafted for controller transport and actor spoof rejection, malformed UUID/JSON/unknown fields/validation, system vs human operation routing, session CSRF fields, security authentication/CSRF, safe errors, oversized request rejection, and static asset accessibility/security assumptions.
